TextObject.Text: NAME AND ADDRESS OF MONEY LENDER :

TextObject.Name: Text12
TextObject.Text: Agricultreal Loan, Industrial Loan, Trade Loan, Personal Loan and Miscellaneous Loan

TextObject.Name: Text2
TextObject.Text: N.B. - A separate statement shall be furnished in respect of each loan transaction : In case of loan in kind there shall be reference to the commodity advanced along with marketvalue if the same at the date of each transaction. Explanation : 1 Agricultural loan means loan for cultivation of crops and allied purposes in connection with agriculture. 2 Industrial loan means for manufacturing purpose. 3 Trade loan means for trade i.e. buying and selling goods or other property movalble or immovable. 4 Personal loan means loan for paying off old debts, marriage ceremonies, religious ceremonies, personal needs etc. 5 Hypothecation loan means loan against hypothecation of vehicles and goods. 6 Miscellanceous loan includes loan for purposes not covered by (1) to (5) above.
